scope: Spatial representation of eight-bit target tones, measured from post-MDP pixels over aligned 64x64 regions. Not an optical/camera grayscale-level measurement.
initial_host_compile_issue: ARM build without the Kindle feature pulled a cross-compiled fontconfig dependency; using the existing Kindle build feature resolved it. The benchmark itself initializes no platform and uses no codec devices.
initial_prototype_issue: Flat-index phase depended on row width. The final row-based LUT matches an independent 8x8 reference exactly.
initial_device_attempt: The first connection timed out before any device changes. Its lease was released; the user woke the Scribe and enabled SSH for this successful fresh run.
